hook: 差集 L 專場開在L轉盤——名牌用中文，防止走失。
script: labile/labortious/lacerate/lachrymose 先登台，其餘 orphan 接龍。清倉晚會續攤：同字母檢票，義核才是身份證。

members.senseAnchor: (chemistry, physics, biology) readily undergoing change or breakdown; liable to change
members.speakLineEn: Cue the L席-不穩定的: labile walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「L席-不穩定的」出場：labile 一上場梗就黏住——不穩定的；易變的。

members.senseAnchor: a GRE-level vocabulary item meaning closely related to its core sense in academic English
members.speakLineEn: Cue the L席-勤勉的: labortious walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「L席-勤勉的」出場：labortious 一上場梗就黏住——勤勉的。

members.senseAnchor: cut or tear irregularly; deeply hurt the feelings of; distress
members.speakLineEn: Cue the L席-傷害；撕: lacerate walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「L席-傷害；撕」出場：lacerate 一上場梗就黏住——傷害；撕裂。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the L席-悲哀的；: lachrymose walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「L席-悲哀的；」出場：lachrymose 一上場梗就黏住——悲哀的；愛哭的。

members.senseAnchor: a GRE-level vocabulary item meaning closely related to its core sense in academic English
members.speakLineEn: Cue the L席-愛哭的；: lachymose walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「L席-愛哭的；」出場：lachymose 一上場梗就黏住——愛哭的；悲哀的。

members.senseAnchor: of or relating to or obtained from milk (especially sour milk or whey)
members.speakLineEn: Cue the L席-乳的: lactic walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「L席-乳的」出場：lactic 一上場梗就黏住——乳的。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the L席-可悲的；: lamentable walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「L席-可悲的；」出場：lamentable 一上場梗就黏住——可悲的；悲痛的。

members.senseAnchor: a composition that imitates or misrepresents somebody's style, usually in a humorous way; ridicule with satire
members.speakLineEn: Cue the L席-公開諷刺: lampoon walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「L席-公開諷刺」出場：lampoon 一上場梗就黏住——公開諷刺。

related.synonyms: parody, spoof, sendup, mockery, takeoff, burlesque

members.speakLineEn: Cue the L席-憔悴的；: languid walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「L席-憔悴的；」出場：languid 一上場梗就黏住——憔悴的；衰弱的。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the L席-v. 變: languish walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「L席-v. 變」出場：languish 一上場梗就黏住——v. 變得衰弱。

members.senseAnchor: a relaxed comfortable feeling; a feeling of lack of interest or energy
members.speakLineEn: Cue the L席-衰弱；懶: languor walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「L席-衰弱；懶」出場：languor 一上場梗就黏住——衰弱；懶惰。

related.synonyms: dreaminess, lassitude, listlessness, lethargy, sluggishness, phlegm

members.senseAnchor: an unintentional departure from truth or accuracy

members.speakLineZh: 請「L席-n. 失」出場：lapse 一上場梗就黏住——n. 失誤。

members.senseAnchor: a gift or money given (as for service or out of benevolence); usually given ostentatiously; liberality in bestowing gifts; extremely liberal and generous of spirit
members.speakLineEn: Cue the L席-贈送；饋: largess walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「L席-贈送；饋」出場：largess 一上場梗就黏住——贈送；饋贈。

members.senseAnchor: a state of comatose torpor (as found in sleeping sickness); a feeling of lack of interest or energy
members.speakLineEn: Cue the L席-無精打採: lassitude walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「L席-無精打採」出場：lassitude 一上場梗就黏住——無精打採；疲乏。
